Wallet-as-a-service / embedded wallet and account-abstraction infrastructure (originally for Web3 gaming), founded Sept 2022 by brothers Joan and Jaume Alavedra, who went through the PearX accelerator. May 2023: $3M seed co-led by gumi Cryptos Capital and Maven 11, with Game7, NGC Ventures and Newman Capital. GamesBeat says it had raised $3.5M to date (amount_raised), presumably including the undisclosed Pear/PearX pre-seed. No later round found.

description: AI agent platform for automating complex enterprise workflows
EHR and billing platform for interventional psychiatry practices
funding_notes: Verified domain osmind.org; San Francisco-based public benefit corporation building an EHR, billing and research platform for interventional psychiatry (ketamine, SPRAVATO, TMS), co-founded by Lucia Huang (CEO) and Jimmy Qian. $2M seed in Oct 2020 led by General Catalyst (YC and Pear also backers); $15M Series A in July 2021 led by Future Ventures; $40M Series B in May 2022 led by DFJ Growth, with a company-stated total of $57M. No later rounds found. Pear entered at Pre-Seed. The Series A investor list beyond Future Ventures/GC/Tiger is from search summaries of the BusinessWire PR, which timed out on direct fetch.

description: Agentic AI data engineering platform
funding_notes: Verified domain osmos.io; agentic AI data engineering / external data ingestion platform founded late 2019 by ex-Google Cloud AI leads Kirat Pandya (CEO) and Naresh Venkat. July 28, 2021: emerged from stealth with $13M led by Lightspeed, with CRV, Pear and SV Angel. Lightspeed's post calls this the Series A and says it built on Lightspeed's own earlier seed investment; VentureBeat's $13M figure may include that seed, so amount_raised is $13M rather than a sum. Microsoft announced the acquisition of Osmos on Jan 5, 2026, folding it into Microsoft Fabric (terms undisclosed). Pear entered at Seed.

description: Income pooling and liquidity products for high-potential founders
funding_notes: Verified domain pandopooling.com; Pando (303 Holdings, Inc.), a San Francisco income-pooling platform (started with pro baseball players, then founders and professionals), founded 2017 by Stanford GSB grads Charlie Olson (CEO) and Eric Lax. TechCrunch (June 2020): $3.3M seed after the fall 2017 launch (Ulu, Pear VC, Avalon, Nimble, StartX), then an $8.5M Series A raised in 2019 led by Core Innovation Capital (Kathleen Utecht), announced June 9, 2020. The PR says 'over $8 million'. amount_raised sums the two rounds ($3.3M+$8.5M). Exact seed date not given beyond 2017. No later rounds found. Pear entered at Pre-Seed.

description: Simulation platform for testing robots before factory deployment
funding_notes: Verified domain parallaxworlds.com; simulation/digital-twin platform for stress-testing robots before factory deployment, co-founded by Tanmay Agarwal (CEO, Stanford robotics) and Aumkar Renavikar (CTO). Nov 20, 2025: $4M seed led by Pear VC with GS Futures, Kakao Ventures, Lightscape Partners and angel groups, bringing total funding to $4.9M including an earlier pre-seed (pre-seed investors/amount not itemized; roughly $0.9M implied). amount_raised is the stated $4.9M total. Pear's investment came at the Seed stage.

description: AI-generated appeals platform for insurance denials and coverage
funding_notes: Input domain paxosappeals.com; the company is now Paxos Health at paxoshealth.com (its About page lists info@paxosappeals.com as an alias). Palo Alto-based AI platform for prior authorizations and insurance-denial appeals for medtech and diagnostics makers, co-founded at Stanford by Haley King (CEO), Alex Lacey (CPO) and Malcolm Asher. The company's 2026 job posting (Pear VC job board via Built In, removed July 2026) says Paxos is seed-stage and has 'raised >$6M across two VC rounds, including our recently closed Seed', with no seed amount, date or investor names. Trackers list Pear, Peterson Partners, Mighty Capital, Honey Stone and Laconia, but no primary source confirms them. Caveat: seed+ rests only on the company's own statement in a job ad, with no press announcement found. Downgrade to unclear-round-type if a formal announcement is required. Pear entered at Pre-Seed.

funding_notes: Verified domain pearlstreettechnologies.com; Pearl Street Technologies, Pittsburgh, a 2018 Carnegie Mellon spin-out (CEO David Bromberg) making SUGAR and Interconnect software to automate grid interconnection studies. VoLo Earth's blog says it led the seed round, with managing partner Kareem joining the board. The Enverus PR lists backers VoLo Earth, Pear VC, Powerhouse Ventures and Incite. A ~$2.8M seed (~2022) appears only on trackers (Tracxn/Dealroom), so amount and date are blank. Acquired by Enverus (announced Mar 13, 2025, terms undisclosed). Grants: DOE SBIR Phase I $199,981 (awarded June 27, 2019). Climate Impact Capital mentions further NSF SBIR Phase I/II and ARPA-E support, but no agency record with amounts was found, so these are not listed. Pear entered at Seed.

description: Digital marketplace connecting commodity buyers and smallholder farmers
funding_notes: Real company site is pempem.org (input pempem.io is its email/app domain; contact care@pempem.io). Montreal, QC-based with Indonesian offices (Jakarta, Pekanbaru; PT. Pemasok Mitra Pembeli); digital marketplace/supply-chain tools for palm-oil smallholders; founder-CEO Joann de Zegher; PearX W22. Company news post (May 2022) says it closed an oversubscribed $1.3M pre-seed on a SAFE ($10M cap) in March 2022 with Pear VC among investors. A June 2025 $3M round led by Pear VC is reported only as a 'venture round' by the SaaSed weekly Canadian funding roundup (Substack newsletter) and trackers, which label it inconsistently (seed/Series A); no press release or major-outlet coverage found, so round type is unclear and the total (~$4.3M) is left blank.

description: AI-powered eDiscovery platform for legal document redaction
funding_notes: Verified domain phase.law; New York-based (228 Park Ave S) AI-native eDiscovery platform starting with redaction consistency; CEO Josh Schwartz (ex-CTO Chartbeat). Company blog (Apr 21, 2025) and Law.com Legaltech News report $2.8M 'in funding' led by Pear and Defined with BoxGroup and Twelve Below (Law.com also notes Gunderson Dettmer partners invested). Neither source labels the round as pre-seed or seed, so round type is unclear. No later rounds found.

description: Online pharmacy delivering NHS and private prescriptions to your door
funding_notes: Verified domain pillsorted.com; London-based personalised prescription-delivery pharmacy (NHS and private), founded 2019 by pharmacist/CEO Zeinab Ardeshir. $6M (~£4.7-4.8M) seed in April 2022 with Pear VC, Hoxton Ventures, Edison Partners and the DoorDash founders (Tech.eu, TechCrunch, UKTN, BusinessCloud); the sources fetched name no explicit lead, so none is marked. No later priced rounds found.

description: Cardless fuel payments platform for commercial fleets
funding_notes: Input domain piston.com does not match; the company's real domain is usepiston.com (per its press release). Piston Technologies, Cupertino, CA (hubs in Lehi, UT and Kolkata), cardless QR-code fuel payments for fleets; co-founders Vikram Sekhon (CEO) and Shivam Shah. June 10, 2025 ACCESS Newswire release: $6.1M seed led by Spark Capital with Pear VC and BOND, following a $1.4M pre-seed via PearX W25, total $7.5M (Pear's own blog headlines the whole $7.5M as the seed).

description: Media tech powering hyperlocal content discvoery
AI-powered revenue intelligence platform
funding_notes: Verified domain pocus.com; product-led sales / revenue intelligence platform, founded 2021 by Alexa Grabell (CEO) and Isaac. June 22, 2022 company blog announced $23M across two rounds (seed and a Series A led by Coatue with First Round, BoxGroup, GTM Fund, Mantis VC); the seed/Series A split was not disclosed, so recorded as one combined entry. Acquired by Apollo.io (announced Mar 19, 2026; terms undisclosed).

description: Photo and video AI editor
funding_notes: Verified domain polarr.com; Bay Area AI photo/video editing company (CEO Borui Wang, CTO Derek Yan). $11.5M Series A led by Threshold Ventures with Pear and Cota Capital (TechCrunch, Mar 2019), bringing total funding to ~$13.5M per the company (earlier ~$2M seed not itemized). Acquired by Pixieset in May 2025 per co-founder Derek Yan's site (terms undisclosed); Pixieset is sunsetting Polarr Next on Oct 13, 2026 in favor of Pixieset Photo Editor.

description: AI platform for local government service delivery
funding_notes: Verified domain polimorphic.com; New York-based AI platform for local/state government resident services (AI Front Desk, CRM), co-founded by Parth Shah (CEO) and Daniel at MIT; PearX S19. $5.6M seed led by M13 with Pear and Shine (Nov 2023), then $18.6M Series A led by General Catalyst with M13 and Shine (BusinessWire, Jul 9, 2025). Total $24.2M is the sum of announced rounds; small post-PearX raises in 2019-20 mentioned by Pear are undisclosed.

description: Card issuing and payments infrastructure for Latin America
Mechanoporation platform for intracellular delivery and cell engineering

funding_notes: Verified domain portal.bio; Watertown/Cambridge, MA mechanoporation cell-engineering platform founded 2023 by Armon Sharei (SQZ Biotech founder); emerged from stealth Dec 2023. $5M pre-seed led by Pear VC (Mar 2024), $7M seed led by IA Ventures (Dec 2024), and an oversubscribed $9M 'financing round' led by NFX (BusinessWire, Jun 18, 2026; the release does not name the stage, though Dealroom calls it a seed). Total $21M is the sum of announced equity rounds. Separately holds an initial $8M DARPA contract (non-dilutive, expanded via the EEI program), recorded under grants and kept out of the equity total. The input lists Series A, but no Series A announcement was found.

description: The first foundation model for the electric grid
funding_notes: Verified domain pravah.com (Pravāh); Stanford-founded AI/foundation-model and physics-based grid intelligence startup for utilities and power systems, co-founders Mohak Mangal (CEO), Dhruv Suri (CTO) and Aman Gupta; PearX S25; works with utilities in the US, Germany and India. The company site names Vinod Khosla (Khosla Ventures), Sara Guo (Conviction) and Mar Hershenson (Pear VC) as backers, and Times of India (Nov 2025) confirms Khosla, Pear and Conviction backing. Funding amount (~$7M, or $7.5M in a later job listing) appears only on the company's own social profile and a Built In job post, with no round type, date or press release, so it is left out of rounds and total. Treated as unclear-round-type.

description: AI property manager for short-term rental hosts
funding_notes: Verified domain prohost.ai (ProhostAI); New York City-based AI property manager / 'AI employees' platform for short-term rental hosts; co-founders Bill Ulammandakh (CEO, ex-Airbnb) and Andrew Lawson (CTO, ex-Dropbox); YC Summer 2024. The company's About page says it has raised $2.6M from investors including Y Combinator and Pear VC, cumulative and with no round breakdown, dates or leads. Trackers mention a ~$1.5M 2024 'seed', but no press release or news confirms a priced seed, so round type is unclear (likely YC/accelerator plus SAFE-style early money).

description: Semiconductor IP for on-device AI inference
funding_notes: Input domain quadric.io is the legacy domain; the company now uses quadric.ai (same Quadric, Inc., Burlingame, CA; CEO Veerbhan Kheterpal, co-founders from 21 Inc./Earn.com). Licenses programmable GPNPU (Chimera) AI-inference processor IP. Seed led by Pear (amount undisclosed), $15M Series A led by DENSO/NSITEXE (May 2019), $21M Series B led by NSITEXE (Mar 2022), $30M Series C first close led by ACCELERATE Fund/BEENEXT (Jan 2026; total then $72M), and a $16M second close led by IFC (Jul 2026), bringing the Series C to $46M and total raised to $90M per the company.

description: Employee financial wellness platform with earned wage access
funding_notes: Domain quansa.io not fetched directly, but company name, description and Pear accelerator link match. Quansa is a Chile/Brazil employer-sponsored financial-wellness and earned-wage-access fintech founded 2020 by Mafalda Barros and Gonzalo Blanco (Stanford Startup Garage, Pear accelerator). $3.6M seed led by Valor Capital Group with Pear VC, Canary, Norte, Magma, Sequoia Scouts and angels (press release via LAVCA, Jul 2021; LatamList, Exame). No later rounds found.

description: RNA-sensing mRNA therapeutics that target specific cell types
funding_notes: Input website rnasensing.bio is the Stanford academic RADAR (RNA sensing using ADAR) resource site from the co-founders' lab, not the company's site; the company's domain is radartx.bio. Radar Therapeutics, Berkeley, CA; CEO Sophia Lugo, CSO Eerik Kaseniit, co-founders Xiaojing Gao (Stanford) and Jim Collins (MIT). Oversubscribed $13.4M seed led by NfX Bio with Eli Lilly, Biovision, KdT, Pear VC, BEVC and others (BusinessWire, May 23, 2024). No later rounds found.

description: End-to-end platform for translational proteomics
funding_notes: Verified domain range.bio; San Francisco-based translational proteomics company (high-throughput multiplexed protein quantification) founded by Stanford labmates Brandon Wilson (CEO) and Nicolo Maganzini (CTO) with Prof. Tom Soh. $5.2M seed led by ARTIS Ventures with Pear VC, Page One, Civilization Ventures, Pillar, Four Cities Capital, Hawktail and others (GlobeNewswire, Jun 12, 2023). No later rounds found.

description: Social app for live sports data and fan discussion
funding_notes: Verified domain: realapp.link redirects to realapp.com (Real Sports App); legal entity Real Vault, Inc. (SEC address Westmont, IL, Chicago area). Social live box-score/play-by-play app founded 2020 (beta)/2021 by brothers John and Louis Antonelli; ~700K-900K DAU per Front Office Sports. FOS (Apr 13, 2026) reports The Chernin Group led a minority-stake round with past/present investors Pear, Tamarisk Lane, Operator Partners and NBA players; amount and valuation undisclosed. SEC Form D (filed 2026-04-21) shows $12,090,494 equity sold, first sale 2026-02-27, 25 investors, matching that round. Round type not stated in any allowed source: trackers conflict (Caplight/input say Series A, Tracxn says Series B) and the 'Series A' label appears only on LinkedIn, so marked unclear-round-type. Earlier rounds (a reported 2022 seed with Pear) have no public amount.

description: Transcript-based platform for searching and editing video
funding_notes: Verified domain reduct.video; San Francisco-based transcript-based video search/editing platform (CEO Prabhas Pokharel, CTO Robert Ochshorn); customers have included Intuit, Autodesk, Facebook, Spotify. $4M round led by Greylock and South Park Commons, with angels Dylan Field, Armando Mann and Elad Gil (TechCrunch and company blog, Feb 11, 2021). Greylock's investment post says it 'signed up to lead the seed', and its portfolio page lists first partnered at Seed. No later rounds found. Pear's check is not broken out.

description: Hybrid human-AI care navigation for health systems
funding_notes: Verified domain relyhealth.care (www redirects); AI-plus-human care navigation / patient orchestration ('AI front desk with a human in the loop') for health systems. Formed in Feb 2023 when Healthful, a startup incubated by Inflect Health (Vituity's innovation hub), merged with Sympto and expanded as Rely Health; Inflect's post (seen only in search snippets, page blocked) notes Pear VC's Mar Hershenson took part. Backed by Inflect Health and Pear, but no amount, date or round type is disclosed in any allowed source. Pear's portfolio lists Series A, and a Caplight figure (~$2.08M) doesn't clearly match this company; neither was used. Caveat: an unrelated 'Rely' (real-estate diligence, $4.5M seed led by 2048 Ventures) shows up in searches and is not this company.

description: AI platform automating sales commissions and incentive management
funding_notes: Verified domain remuner.com; Barcelona, Spain-based AI sales-compensation/commission platform founded 2023 (CEO Sergio González). Pre-seed of €2M led by Pear VC (Jan 2024; K Fund, Bonsai Partners, Enzo Ventures, Wayra, BStartup and angels). €5.5M (~$6.5M) seed led by Seaya with significant Pear VC participation (Sept 2025, EU-Startups/Tech.eu/company blog); Beatriz González (Seaya) and Pepe Agell (Pear) joined the board. Total about €7.5M.

description: Packaging sustainability and EPR compliance platform for brands
AI underwriting platform for catastrophe-exposed property insurers
funding_notes: Verified domain resiquant.ai; San Francisco-based AI underwriting/property-intelligence platform for catastrophe-exposed (seismic, wind, wildfire) property insurers, founded by Stanford Blume Center structural-engineering PhDs Omar Issa (CEO) and Francisco Galvis; PearX S24. $4M seed led by LDV Capital with Foothill Ventures, Pear VC, Alumni Ventures and angels (company release Mar 14, 2025; The Insurer). SEC Form D (filed Jan 2025) shows $4,649,996 equity sold, first sale 2024-12-23, 8 investors; it likely includes the seed plus earlier money, so amount_raised uses the announced $4M. No Series A found.

description: Embedded integrations platform for SaaS products
funding_notes: Verified domain rollouthq.com (now branded at rollout.com); co-founder AK Lalani; reportedly Austin, TX. Started as an embedded Zapier-style integrations platform for SaaS (matches the input), rebuilt as Rollout V2 in 2023, and now sells a 'Universal API' for real estate and mortgage CRMs, transaction management and LOS systems. Pear lists it as a portfolio company (Seed), but no press release, news report or SEC Form D with a funding amount or round was found. Trackers cite a ~$3.81M seed in Jan 2020 (Base10, Musha Ventures, Pear, Reform Ventures), but that relies only on PitchBook-type data and isn't used here.

description: AI operating system for defense and aerospace procurement
funding_notes: Verified domain salespatriot.com; Polish-American (US plus Warsaw R&D centre) AI procurement platform for defense and aerospace parts distributors and manufacturers, founded 2024 by Nelson Ray (CEO), Benjamin Rhodes-Kropf (CTO) and Maciej Szymczyk; YC-backed. $5M seed led by CRV with Pear VC, Y Combinator, SV Angel, Liquid2, Uncorrelated Ventures and angels (Tech.eu/EU-Startups, Oct 28, 2025), bringing total funding to $6.3M. The ~$1.3M earlier pre-seed/YC money is not broken out. No Series A found.

description: AI platform for banks and fintechs to build and own AI apps
funding_notes: Verified domain savviai.com; SAVVI AI Inc. (SEC address Kentfield, CA), platform letting banks, credit unions and fintechs build and own governed AI apps/agents (founded 2020). SEC Form D filings show a 2021 convertible-note offering ($1,325,000 sold, first sale 2021-01-29, 11 investors; excluded from the equity total) and a 2023 equity offering ($5,468,184 sold of $7,137,680 offered, first sale 2023-09-01, 36 investors). Chicago Ventures lists it as a 2023 portfolio company. No press release or reputable news names the round type or lead: trackers variously call it seed or Series A (input says Series A), so it's marked unclear-round-type.

description: AI agent that automates outbound sales pipeline building
funding_notes: Verified domain sellscale.com; San Francisco AI outbound-sales/SDR automation company founded by Ishan Sharma (CEO) and Aakash Adesara (ex-Athelas; DailyDropout.FYI). The company blog (Nov 17, 2022) announces a $3.4M 'inception round' led by Pear VC (Pejman Nozad), and TechCrunch (Dec 6, 2022) reports it as $3M led by Pear with Ovo Fund and Browder Capital. Pear's portfolio shows it entered at Pre-Seed, and the round isn't called a seed in any primary source, so it's treated as pre-seed. No later priced seed or Series A found (Pear lists the current stage as Seed; trackers call the round seed). Caveat: it could be argued as unclear-round-type.

Redesigned tampon engineered for comfort and reliability
funding_notes: Verified domain trysequel.com; Sequel (US, remote team of about 7) makes a patented spiral-design tampon, FDA-cleared 2023; founded 2018 by Stanford engineers and athletes Greta Meyer and Amanda Calabrese. Launched Dec 21, 2021 with a $5M seed (BusinessWire/Femtech Insider) from MaC VC, Pear Accelerator, Long Journey, Ulu, Graph Ventures and angels. Forbes calls it combined pre-seed and seed money, with MaC VC as lead. Sportico (Mar 2026) says Sequel has raised over $8M (per Forbes, June 2025), with investors including RRE Ventures, and that Tipt Ventures invested in late 2025 (amount undisclosed); an official Series A is planned. amount_raised = the 'over $8M' reported total, so treat it as a lower bound.

description: AI-powered social network connecting users via iMessage
funding_notes: Verified domain series.so; AI social network that works through iMessage, making double opt-in introductions. Founded 2025 by Yale students Nathaneo Johnson (CEO) and Sean Hargrow; office in Chelsea, New York. $3.1M pre-seed led by Parable (Anne Lee Skates) with Pear VC, DGB.VC and others (GlobeNewswire, Apr 2025). TechCrunch (Apr 24, 2026) reports a $5.1M pre-seed. The $5.1M likely includes the earlier $3.1M (not stated), so amount_raised = $5.1M, not $8.2M. A Business Insider URL slug mentions 'seed', but every primary report calls it pre-seed.

description: Virtual mental health care for mothers and women
funding_notes: Verified domain sevenstarling.com; Washington, DC-based (launched from New York) virtual women's/perinatal mental health provider, founded by HBS grads Tina Beilinson Keshani (CEO) and Sophia Richter; PearX S20. $2.9M seed co-led by Pear VC, Expa and Magnify Ventures (Sept 2021); $10.9M Series A led by RH Capital (July 2024); $8M Series A-Prime led by Rethink Impact (Sept 2025, per the press release and Mintz). Total about $21.8M. Operates in 18 states and targets 30+ by end of 2026.

description: AI assistant for scheduling, tasks, and workflow automation
Marketplace to rent private land as dog parks
funding_notes: Verified domain sniffspot.com; Seattle-founded (2018, CEO David Adams) marketplace for renting private yards and land as dog parks, which moved to a membership model in late 2024. Inc. (July 3, 2026) reports $4.4M raised to date, no new capital since 2020, revenue up from $3M (2024) to $6M (2025), ~40 staff, and cash-flow positive. No allowed source gives round types, dates or leads. Trackers describe a ~$4.5M seed with Pear VC, Unpopular Ventures and Leap Venture Studio (latest Oct 2020), but that isn't used, so it's marked unclear-round-type. Pear entered at Pre-Seed.

description: Payment and financing platform for veterinary practices
funding_notes: SnoutID now operates as Snout (snoutid.com redirects to snout.com); pet wellness-plan financing platform for veterinary clinics, founded 2023 by Emily Dong per Fortune, offices in Michigan/San Francisco/New York. On 2026-01-28 announced a $10M Series A led by Footwork with existing investors Pear, Bread and Butter Ventures, Restive Ventures (Footwork's post also names Griffon Partners), plus a separate $100M debt/financing facility from Clear Haven Capital Management (debt, excluded from equity total). Earlier pre-seed/seed amounts not publicly disclosed, so $10M is only the disclosed equity.

description: AI agents for fraud and risk team investigations
funding_notes: Verified getsocratix.ai. Bay Area/San Francisco company (founded 2025 by Riya Jagetia and Satya Vasanth Tumati, YC-backed) building AI coworkers for fraud and risk investigations. Announced a $4.1M seed round on 2025-10-28 led by Pear VC with Y Combinator, Twenty Two Ventures, Transpose Platform Management and angels. No later rounds found.

description: AI-powered conversational automation platform
funding_notes: Solvvy (solvvy.com, now offline after acquisition), Palo Alto, CA conversational AI/self-service customer support platform led by founding CEO Mahesh Ram. Raised a $12M Series A on 2017-10-23 led by Scale Venture Partners with existing investors Pear Ventures, Signatures Capital and True Ventures, bringing total funding to $16.5M (the ~$4.5M of earlier funding is not itemized publicly). Zoom announced the acquisition on 2022-05-12 and closed it 2022-05-19 for $121.2M cash per Zoom's SEC filing.

description: Agentic QA platform for e-commerce sites
funding_notes: Verified spurtest.com. New York City-based agentic QA company (YC, founded 2024 by Yale grads Sneha Sivakumar and Anushka Nijhawan) using AI browser agents to test e-commerce/consumer sites. Raised $4.5M seed announced 2025-04-17, led by First Round Capital (Liz Wessel) with Pear VC, Neo, Conviction, Liquid2Ventures, Predictive Venture Partners and angels. No later rounds found.

description: All-in-one e-commerce platform for content creators
funding_notes: Verified stan.store. Creator storefront/monetization platform founded 2020 by John Hu and Vitalii Dodonov (Los Angeles area). Its only priced round is a $5M seed led by Forerunner Ventures (announced around Jan/Feb 2022; some sources say 2021) with Pear VC and angels Kevin Hartz and Michael Ovitz; Forbes (Aug 2025) says it has been profitable since and hasn't needed more capital. In 2025 Steven Bartlett (May) and Gary Vaynerchuk (Sept) invested on undisclosed terms (per Contrary Research), not counted in the total.

description: AI-powered provider analytics and insights
AI-powered procurement and vendor management platform
funding_notes: Verified sudozi.com. Austin, TX finance/procurement and vendor-management software founded by Rose Punkunus (former CFO of Uber U.S. & Canada). Closed a $4.3M seed round announced 2022-05-12, led by Pear VC with S3 Ventures, Mischief and 40+ angels. Acquired by Zone & Co (announced 2026-04-09), terms not disclosed.

description: Community-driven fitness platform building connections through movement
funding_notes: Verified sweatpals.com. Austin, TX community fitness marketplace for in-person workouts/events, co-founded by Salar Shahini (CEO) and Mandi Zhou. Raised $12M seed announced 2025-10-28, led by Patron, a16z speedrun and Kevin Hart's HartBeat Ventures, with WndrCo, Antler, Pear, Max Mullen and Deb Liu; company says this brings total funding to $17.2M. The earlier ~$5.2M (pre-seed/earlier rounds) is not itemized publicly.

description: The snap-on smart light switch
funding_notes: Switchmate Inc. (Pleasanton, CA; Robert Romano exec/director), maker of a snap-on smart light switch; it rebranded as Simply Smart Home (input site mysimplysmarthome.com, whose About page says the company was originally Switchmate). The only public funding record is an SEC Form D for $350,000 equity, first sale 2014-10-14 (round type not stated; Pear lists it as a Pre-Seed investment; trackers also name Highway1 and Dunelm Energy). No priced seed or later round found. Pear's portfolio marks it Acquired, but no acquisition announcement was found; it appears to be a rebrand, not an acquisition.

description: AI-powered instructional feedback for teachers
funding_notes: Verified teachfx.com. Bay Area (Stanford-origin) AI instructional feedback app for teachers, founded by Jamie Poskin (CEO) and Berk Coker. $10M Series A announced 2022-09-29, led by Reach Capital with Osage Venture Partners, Pearson Ventures, Brighteye Ventures, Ulu Ventures and Newfund. The founder letter confirms an earlier seed round (Reach, Brighteye, Ulu, Newfund); Reach says it first invested in 2017. Seed amounts are only on trackers (Dealroom: ~$350K Jun 2017 with Pear/Reach and ~$1.1M Nov 2017), not confirmed by primary sources, so the equity total counts only the $10M Series A.

description: AI platform for differentiated curriculum development
funding_notes: Verified teachshare.com. AI platform for teachers to plan, differentiate and assess curriculum, launched January 2024 by UC Berkeley dropouts Aryan Bhadouria (CEO) and Adam Goldstein (CTO); Forbes 30 Under 30 Education 2026. Forbes says the founders have raised $2.3M from groups including Reach Capital; Pear backed it at pre-seed per Pear's portfolio. No public announcement naming a priced seed round (only trackers call it seed), so round type is unclear. Cumulative total, possibly multiple rounds.

description: AI monetization infrastructure for retailers and marketplaces
funding_notes: Verified topsort.com. San Francisco retail media / auction-based ad infrastructure for retailers and marketplaces, founded 2021 by Regina Ye (CEO), Francisco Larrain and Stanford GSB professor Michael Ostrovsky. Seed announced 2022-03-10 at a $110M valuation (TechCrunch/FinSMEs report $8M; the company's 2024 release says $8.6M, which is used here). $20M Series A announced 2024-03-04 led by Upload Ventures with returning Quiet Capital and Pear Ventures, at a $150M valuation. Total equity is about $28.6M ($28M if the seed was $8M). Trackers mention a 2021 pre-seed; not counted.

description: Real-time, utilization based mobile offers for local restaurants
funding_notes: TownHound was a San Francisco app offering real-time, off-peak mobile deals for local restaurants, co-founded around 2015 by Bryan Solar and Alex Russell. Founder bios report it was acquired by Google in 2016, about eight months after launch; terms not disclosed. The input website (ads.google.com) is the acquirer's product, not TownHound's own domain, which appears defunct. Pear lists it as a Pre-Seed investment; no public round amount or priced round was found.

description: Ceramide-based oral delivery platform for biologic drugs

grants.name: NIH/NIDDK SBIR Phase I (1R43DK134260-01A1): oral GLP-1 ceramide conjugates

funding_notes: Transcera Inc. (Cambridge, MA; SBIR contacts use @transcera.bio emails; transcera.bio now redirects to transcera.com) is building a ceramide/glycosphingolipid platform for oral delivery of biologics such as GLP-1, based on Harvard professor Wayne Lencer's research; CEO Hunter Goble, CSO Justin Wolfe; PearX S21. Announced a seed round in July 2023 led by Xora Innovation (Temasek), with Tau Ventures and existing pre-seed investors Pear, Digitalis Ventures and KdT Ventures; amount not disclosed. Also won an NIH SBIR Phase I grant of $324,905 (2023), listed only under grants.

description: AI platform for creating, sharing, and watching animated short videos
funding_notes: Trimz (trimz.ai now redirects to trimz.tv), San Francisco app for creating and watching AI-generated animated/anime short series, founded by Nicholas Pezzotti and Nikhil Gopalam. Pear lists a Pre-Seed investment. Only trackers (Caplight/PitchBook-class) mention a round around July 2025, with no amount; no press release or news coverage found.

description: Online bra fitting service and shop
funding_notes: Verified trueandco.com (True&Co), San Francisco online bra-fit quiz and lingerie retailer founded 2012 by Michelle Lam. $2M seed in May 2012 (First Round, SoftTech VC, SoftBank Capital, Aileen Lee) and $4M more in Oct 2013 (Crosslink, VegasTechFund, Pejman Nozad, FundersClub plus existing investors). TechCrunch doesn't name the 2013 round; trackers call it Series A. Disclosed rounds total $6M, but TechCrunch (2017) says it raised a reported $13M in total, so later rounds went undisclosed. PVH (Calvin Klein's owner) acquired it in March 2017 for an undisclosed price, reportedly in the tens of millions, with investors mostly getting their money back.

description: AI utility management for multi-location businesses
funding_notes: Verified truemeter.com (formerly EcoTrove; PearX W25), AI utility-bill management and energy savings for multi-location brick-and-mortar businesses, co-founded by Ozge Islegen-Wojdyla and Ali Sarilgan (Stanford). $4M seed announced 2025-09-10, led by Ulu Ventures with Pear VC, e2.vc, RiverPark, Flex Capital, Sarah Smith Fund, Cyan, Costanoa and Sand Hill Angels. Company and Pear say total funding is now more than $5.5M; the earlier ~$1.5M (pre-seed) isn't itemized, and $5.5M is a floor.

description: AI takeoffs for paving contractors from aerial imagery
funding_notes: Verified trutec.ai (TruTec.ai, Inc., formerly Skyvo.ai, Inc.; Delaware), AI paving/landscaping/roofing takeoffs from aerial imagery plus estimating/CRM software; executives Ross Stitts (CEO) and Ryan Brown. SEC Form D filed 2026-07-09 (Rule 506(b)) reports $4,609,993 equity sold to 8 investors, first sale 2026-05-29, including $500,000 of cancelled (converted) convertible debt. The filing doesn't name the round; tracker sites and a founder social post (excluded) call it a seed, and Pear lists it as Seed, but no press release or news coverage confirms a priced seed, so it's classified unclear-round-type. Investors not named in public sources beyond Pear's portfolio listing.

description: Real-time AI governance agent for regulated industries
AI platform for optimizing battery energy storage assets
funding_notes: Verified tyba.ai (Tyba Energy), San Francisco AI forecasting, trading and optimization platform for battery storage and solar projects; CEO and co-founder Michael Baker. $2.25M seed announced 2023-01-24, co-led by Powerhouse Ventures and Wireframe Ventures. $13.9M Series A announced 2025-02-06, led by Energize Capital with new investors Pear VC, Mobilize Climate Capital and Borusan Ventures plus follow-ons. Company-stated total funding is $18.15M (the remaining ~$2M is not itemized publicly).

description: Data infrastructure for production-ready AI workloads
funding_notes: typedef.ai verified (company blog + PR Newswire). AI data processing engine (open-source Fenic DataFrame framework); co-founders Yoni Michael and Kostas Pardalis. Emerged from stealth June 18, 2025 with a $5.5M seed led by Pear VC with Verissimo Ventures, Monochrome, Tokyo Black and angels. No later round found.

description: FDA-cleared agentic AI platform for clinical care delivery
funding_notes: updoc.ai verified (PR Newswire release links updoc.ai). Palo Alto, CA clinical AI company (CEO Sharif Vakili, MD); announced FDA clearance of a patient-facing LLM SaMD on June 25, 2026 together with $18M in oversubscribed seed financing 'to-date' from ADA (Innovation Fund), Cathay Innovation, Eli Lilly, Mayo Clinic, Oxeon, Pear VC, Polaris Partners and Section 32; no lead named and no tranche dates given. Input status says Series A, but no public Series A announcement was found as of Oct 2026.

description: AI diagnostics for cancer treatment decisions
funding_notes: valarlabs.com verified. Stanford-founded (PearX S21) AI oncology diagnostics company (Vesta bladder-cancer test). Seed of $4.15M led by a16z Bio + Health after Oct 2021 Demo Day (per Pear VC blog; exact close date not public, so date given as 2021 approximate), then $22M Series A co-led by DCVC and a16z with Pear in May 2024; Pear says ~$26M raised in total.

description: Independent benchmarks and evaluation infrastructure for artificial intelligence
funding_notes: vals.ai verified (company blog). Independent AI benchmarking/evaluation company founded by Stanford dropouts Rayan Krishnan and Langston Nashold. Launched April 2024 with an undisclosed pre-seed from Pear VC (+ a Sequoia scout), per Bloomberg as reported by Tech Times. $40M Series A at a $400M valuation announced Aug 13, 2026, led by a16z with existing investors 8VC, Pear VC and Bloomberg Beta and new investors HRT Ventures and NextLadder. Trackers mention a ~$5M seed with 8VC/Bloomberg Beta, but no primary announcement found, so it is not included; amount_raised counts only the disclosed Series A.

description: Automated security compliance and trust management platform
funding_notes: vanta.com verified. San Francisco security compliance / trust management platform (CEO Christina Cacioppo, founded 2018, YC). Series A $50M (Sequoia, May 2021, ~$500M valuation), Series B $110M (Craft Ventures, June 2022, $1.6B), Series C $150M (Sequoia, July 2024, $2.45B), Series D $150M (Wellington, July 23, 2025, $4.15B). Total $504M per Reuters (Reuters page paywalled; figure taken from search summary of the Reuters article); the four listed rounds sum to $460M, the remainder presumably earlier seed money not itemized here. Investor lists for B/C abbreviated.

description: The next generation biophysical assay platform

investors: Mission BioCapital Platinum Program (with sponsors Eli Lilly and Ono Venture Investment)

funding_notes: velocitybio.tech verified (site is a one-page holding page). San Carlos, CA Stanford spinout building a high-throughput biophysical/microfluidic assay platform for allosteric drug discovery. Mission BioCapital's Oct 30, 2024 release names it one of six 2023 Platinum Program winners; winners received undisclosed shares of $3.5M total pre-seed capital plus lab space. Trackers (PitchBook/Caplight, not used) claim a ~$3M seed with Pear VC and others, and a LinkedIn post (not cited) mentions a subaward on a $1.25M NSF Phase II SBIR to partner Cache DNA; neither confirmed by a citable primary source, so no seed+ or grant recorded.
notable_investors: Mission BioCapital Platinum Program (with sponsors Eli Lilly and Ono Venture Investment)

description: International and global expansion platform
funding_notes: via.work verified (Via, a global employer-of-record/payroll platform; legal name appears as VIA Global Ventures). Founded by Stanford GSB sisters Maite and Itziar (PearX). Raised a pre-seed after PearX, pivoted to EOR, and raised a Series A in December 2022 (amount undisclosed); investors named collectively as Industry Ventures, Switch VC, Entree Capital, Burst Capital and Pear (round-by-round attribution not public). Justworks announced a definitive agreement to acquire Via in Sept 2023, terms undisclosed. Series A sourced to Pear VC's own blog only (no independent press found).

description: Synthetic audiences that simulate consumer reactions instantly
funding_notes: viewpoints.ai verified (Viewpoints.ai, simulated jurors and consumer audience panels; founder/CEO Leo Yeykelis, Stanford media-psychology team, U.S. Patent 12,699,820). Pear VC lists it as a pre-seed investment; company describes itself as venture-backed. Trackers (PitchBook/Caplight, not used) list a May 2025 seed with Forerunner, Pear, Sarah Smith Fund and WndrCo, but no public announcement or amount was found, so it is not counted as seed+.

description: AI-powered care coordination platform
funding_notes: viz.ai verified. San Francisco AI care-coordination/stroke-detection platform (CEO Chris Mansi). Series A $21M (Kleiner Perkins, July 2018), Series B $50M (Greenoaks, Oct 2019), Series C $71M (Scale + Insight, Mar 2021), Series D $100M (Tiger Global + Insight, Apr 7, 2022, $1.2B valuation). amount_raised is the sum of these four sourced equity rounds; an earlier seed and a reported ~$40M 2023 debt facility (tracker-only) are excluded.

description: State-of-the-art embedding and reranking models
The mobile app for your wedding day
AI-powered fact extraction, verification, and analysis for dispute teams
funding_notes: wexler.ai verified. London-based litigation fact-intelligence AI (CEO Gregory Mostyn). Undisclosed 2024 pre-seed led by Myriad Venture Partners; $5.3M seed led by Pear VC with Seedcamp, The LegalTech Fund and Myriad announced Sept 23, 2025 (PR Newswire, Tech.eu). Legora announced it was acquiring Wexler on July 29, 2026 (terms undisclosed).

description: Accurate weather forecasts from long-duration balloons and state-of-the-art AI models
funding_notes: windbornesystems.com verified. Palo Alto-founded, Redwood City, CA weather-intelligence company (long-duration sensing balloons + WeatherMesh AI forecasts; CEO John Dean). $15M Series A led by Khosla Ventures (May 2024, Axios) and $37M oversubscribed Series B co-led by Khosla and Galvanize (Business Wire, Aug 5, 2026), bringing total funding to 'more than $62 million' per the company (so amount_raised is a lower bound; earlier pre-seed/seed money not itemized). SEC Form D filings exist under CIK 1979342.

description: Numeric reasoning API for generative AI platforms
funding_notes: woodwide.ai is the company (Pittsburgh, PA; founded 2025 by CMU professor Pradeep Ravikumar and Varsha Raj; numeric/structured-data reasoning API; PearX, AlphaLab and CMU VentureBridge alum). Technical.ly (June 15, 2026) reports a $3M pre-seed from Pear VC, Switch VC and Ardent Venture Partners (close date not given). A Form D appears on a filings aggregator (not checked in detail). Input 'round' says Series A, which is not supported by any public source.

description: AI sourcing & outbound recruiting platform
funding_notes: wrangle.ai verified (AI sourcing and outbound recruiting platform, Pear VC portfolio). Only funding evidence is Pear's pre-seed listing and a Castle Placement roundup saying it 'raised venture funding from Pear' in early Feb 2025 (undisclosed amount; that roundup itself draws on tracker data, so the date is low-confidence). Input status says Seed, but no public seed announcement was found. Do not confuse with Wrangle (wrangle.io, Durham NC Slack help-desk startup) whose $2M 2023 seed led by Accomplice is a different company.

description: Big data analytics and visualization platform
Pioneering thymus-targeted medicines
funding_notes: zagbio.com verified. Cambridge, MA biotech (Polaris-founded/incubated; CEO Jason F. Cole) developing thymus-targeted bifunctional antibodies for autoimmune disease (lead ZAG-101 for Type 1 diabetes). Launched Oct 28, 2025 with $80M total financing 'including a recently closed Series A' co-led by Polaris Partners and T1D Fund; the split between Series A and earlier seed/incubation money is not disclosed, so the full $80M is attributed to the Series A entry. Codon Capital, Alexandria Venture Investments and Gaingels are also listed as investors.

description: AI checkout-free tech for stadiums, colleges, hospitals, and more
funding_notes: getzippin.com verified. San Francisco checkout-free retail tech (CEO Krishna Motukuri; ex-Amazon/SRI founders). $12M Series A led by Kraft Heinz-backed Evolv Ventures (Dec 2019; brought total to $15M), then $30M Series B (Sept 1, 2021) with OurCrowd, Maven Ventures, Evolv and SAP, bringing total funding to 'more than $45 million' per the company (amount_raised is that lower bound). Input status says Series A but a Series B is public. No later round found.

description: E-commerce tools for Latin American retailers
funding_notes: zubale.com verified. Mexico City e-commerce fulfillment software + gig marketplace for LatAm retailers (founded 2018 at HBS by Allison Campbell and Sebastian Monroy). $40M Series A led by QED Investors announced Apr 20, 2022; company states $48M raised in total across rounds (earlier ~$8M seed money from NFX, Maya Capital and others not itemized).

description: AI-powered platform enabling clinicians to deliver high-quality, scalable asynchronous care efficiently to more patients.
funding_notes: Input has no website; identified as Counsel Health (counselhealth.com), a New York-based physician-supervised AI asynchronous care company (CEO Muthu Alagappan, MD), which matches the description and Pear's portfolio. $11M seed led by a16z (Oct 2024) and $25M Series A led by a16z and GV announced Oct 16, 2025, with Asymmetric, Floodgate and Pear VC participating (per Business Wire, WSJ and a16z); total ~$36M.
